description: This file defines a static utility class 'ImageValidators' within the Microsoft.eShopWeb.PublicApi namespace. It provides methods to validate image files based on size and extension, including an extension validation for common image formats like JPG, PNG, GIF, and JPEG.

classes.name: ImageValidators
classes.description: A static class providing methods for validating image files.

methods.name: IsValidImage
methods.description: Extension method that validates if a byte array represents a valid image file based on size and extension.

methods.name: IsExtensionValid
methods.description: Checks if the file extension of the provided filename matches supported image formats.
